steps.content: Before Christina began her investigation, Inspector Dole and his team had already examined every corner of the scene.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Yeah, we've checked. There are signs of damage everywhere, all the clues have been contaminated. Some things have been moved around, and maybe some have been taken away.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Heh... Those announcements sent to the media were timely, why didn't they send us one too?
Whether the criminal sent the letters to destroy the scene or to expose everything as Shalom suggested, it's hard to determine now. But in any case, they were indeed late.
As the operation approaches, FAC faces mounting public pressure. If this is the purpose of the Underground, they've achieved their goal.
For the first time, the "Mentor" didn't leave Christina a puzzle, but instead wreaked havoc on the scene.
Wait... Are there really no puzzles here? No place for her to explore?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Among all 13 elders of the Charity Foundation, why was only one of them moved to another scene?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Why go to the trouble of arranging two symmetrical scenes?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The reason for the retaliation against the Charity Foundation is clear. But even if she's doing this as a payback, this doesn't make sense. She could have just arranged this one extravagant scene. Why...
Christina vaguely realizes that, whether the Mentor intended it or not, both scenes hid some information.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Inspector, I have some ideas. I would like to head back to the third scene later. Before that, there's one more thing at the fourth scene I was hoping you could investigate.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: But this scene has already been completely destroyed.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Isn't there still a clue? The one that even the most gossip-loving reporter didn't dare to touch...
Christina looks at the terrifyingly large bouquet on the dining table, intimidating and fully contaminated by Mania. No one dared to touch it.
Where there are puzzles, there's the possibility of uncovering the truth.
Looking at the determined Christina, Dole can only let out a long sigh. He really can't deal with this intern.

At Christina's strong insistence, the intelligence department tested the flower again.
And the result of this test is as Christina thought. The intelligence department detected the DNA of 12 people on this organism, corresponding exactly to the 12 broken flowers in the conference room.
This is what Coquelic wants to hide. All the feints, and the mystery of the third and fourth lines of the poem, were just to hide a secret, and...
That secret is hidden in the third scene, the conference room!
